title: Cast a Spell
subtitle: Use a spell with a 1-reaction cast time
description: Some spells can be cast as reactions, interrupting the normal flow of turns in response to an event.

bullets.content: The trigger is specified by the spell itself (e.g., casting Shield when you are hit by an attack).

title: Opportunity Attack
subtitle: Attack a foe that leaves your reach
description: You can make an opportunity attack when a hostile creature that you can see moves out of your reach.

items: You use your reaction to make one melee attack against the provoking creature.
The attack occurs right before the creature leaves your reach.
You don't provoke an opportunity attack when you teleport or when someone or something moves you without using your movement, action, or reaction.

bullets.content: This is one of the most common reactions in combat.

title: Readied Action
subtitle: Act on your chosen trigger
description: If you have readied an action, you can use your reaction to act on the specified trigger.

bullets.content: The trigger is the perceivable circumstance you chose as part of your Ready action.

title: Grapple **
subtitle: Special opportunity attack
description: A homebrew rule allowing a grapple check to be made in place of an opportunity attack.

bullets.content: This house rule allows you to use your reaction to grapple a creature leaving your reach. The normal rules for grappling apply:

items: The target must be no more than one size larger than you.
You make a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
If you succeed, the target gains the Grappled condition and its speed becomes 0, stopping its movement.

bullets.content: Always confirm with your Dungeon Master if this house rule is in use.
